question.nlq: Hey! Hope your day is going great. I'm trying to sort through some shipping data and I really need a hand. Could you please list out all the customers who have received shipments containing expensive items? I'd love to see their first names alongside the shipment tracking numbers. Thanks so much!

meanings.hidden_knowledge: For the purpose of this request, the term 'expensive items' is defined as products with a product_price greater than 400.00.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    c.customer_first_name,
    s.shipment_tracking_number
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Shipment_Items si ON oi.order_item_id = si.order_item_id
JOIN Shipments s ON si.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_price > 400.00

meanings.hidden_knowledge: For the purpose of this request, the term 'expensive items' is defined as products with a product_price greater than 600.00.
